paper_id: # One row per candidate paper from the search.
# Save populated file as `screening_decisions.csv` in your project root
# paper_id        | required | OpenAlex work ID (e.g. W2345678901) or DOI. Must match the IDs in the search results (openalex_works.jsonl).
# decision        | required | One of: include / exclude / include_uncertain
# reason          | required | Short prose justification (one sentence). For `exclude`
decision: must reference the specific criterion that failed. For `include_uncertain`

paper_id: # criterion_tag  | required if decision=exclude | Tag from the exclusion-criteria list in question_framing.md (e.g. wrong_outcome
# reviewer       | required | Who made the decision. Conventions: `LLM-pass-1`
criterion_tag: `consensus`. Track human overrides explicitly — do not silently overwrite the LLM row.

paper_id: # notes           | optional but recommended | Verbatim quote from title/abstract that triggered the decision
decision: plus any free-text context. Quote in escaped double quotes.

paper_id: # 1. LLM (or human) populates one row per candidate via 03_screening.md.
# 2. Human reviewer reviews all `exclude` and all `include_uncertain` rows.
# 3. When a human overrides an LLM decision
decision: add a new row with the same paper_id and reviewer=`human-pass-1` (etc.). The latest reviewer entry wins for downstream processing.
